mainTopic: The order of the יום הכפורים offerings: רבי אליעזר vs. רבי עקיבא, the splitting of the seven lambs, one ram or two, and the כהן גדול's final entry to remove the כף and מחתה
overview: This amud opens at the end of a ברייתא that lists רבי עקיבא's order of the כהן גדול's offerings on יום הכפורים. The גמרא explains the reasoning of each side. רבי אליעזר follows the order of the תורה's books, and רבי עקיבא learns from "מלבד עולת הבקר" that the מוספין go with the morning תמיד. The גמרא also explains how רבי אליעזר uses "מלבד חטאת הכפורים": the outer שעיר atones for the same thing as the inner שעיר. Next come two more reports of רבי עקיבא's view, which split the seven lambs between morning and afternoon (1+6 or 6+1). Both reports split them because two פסוקים point to two times. The numbers differ because one side fears the כהן גדול will grow weak and the other fears he will be negligent. The גמרא then notes that all these views count only one ram for the people. That matches רבי, who reads "אחד" as one ram, against רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון, who counts two rams and reads "אחד" as the choicest of the flock. Finally the גמרא returns to the משנה: the כהן גדול washes again and enters to take out the כף and מחתה, and this ברייתא continues on the next amud.

steps.title: The rest of the day's order according to רבי עקיבא
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא finishes listing רבי עקיבא's order: the outer שעיר, then the two rams, then the parts of the חטאת placed on the altar, and finally the afternoon תמיד.
steps.simpleTranslation: And afterward comes the goat whose service is done outside, as it says: "One goat as a sin-offering, besides the sin-offering of atonement." Afterward come his ram and the people's ram. Afterward come the altar-portions of the sin-offering. Afterward comes the afternoon daily offering.
steps.whatsHappening: We are at the end of a ברייתא that lays out רבי עקיבא's order of the יום הכפורים offerings. It finishes the list and gives a פסוק as the source for where the outer שעיר goes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The outer שעיר (the מוסף goat, whose service is done in the עזרה) comes after the special inner service of the day. The proof is the פסוק "מלבד חטאת הכפורים": the outer goat is 'besides' the inner atonement goat, which shows it comes after it. Then come the עולות of the rams, then the אימורים of the inner חטאות, and the day ends with the afternoon תמיד.

keyTerms.meaning: The goat whose service is done outside: the מוסף goat, offered in the courtyard, not in the קודש הקדשים
The sin-offering of atonement: the inner goat of יום הכפורים, whose blood is brought inside
His ram and the people's ram: the two עולות of the day
The parts of the sin-offering that are burned on the altar
The daily afternoon offering, which ends the day's service

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two goats. "חטאת הכפורים" is the INNER goat, whose blood goes into the קודש הקדשים. "שעיר הנעשה בחוץ" is a DIFFERENT goat: the מוסף goat, offered outside in the courtyard.

phrases.english: And afterward, the goat whose service is done outside,
as it is said: "One goat as a sin-offering
besides the sin-offering of atonement,"
phrases.notes: This is from במדבר כט:יא. The word 'besides' shows this goat comes after the inner atonement goat.

phrases.english: and afterward, his ram and the ram of the people,
and afterward, the altar-portions of the sin-offering,

phrases.aramaic: וְאַחַר כָּךְ תָּמִיד שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם.
phrases.english: and afterward, the daily afternoon offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the ברייתא (begun on the previous amud) that lists רבי עקיבא's order of the day.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In רבי עקיבא's order, after the inner service come: the outer שעיר, then the two rams, then the אימורי חטאת, then the afternoon תמיד.

steps.title: What is רבי אליעזר's reason?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of רבי אליעזר's order.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason of רבי אליעזר?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now moves from the ברייתא to analyzing the dispute. It asks why רבי אליעזר orders the offerings the way he does; this sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר puts the rams and the מוסף offerings after the special service of the day, unlike רבי עקיבא. The גמרא wants to know what this order is based on.

keyTerms.meaning: The תנא who disagrees with רבי עקיבא about the order

phrases.english: What is the reason of Rabbi Eliezer?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns from quoting the ברייתא to explaining the two opinions.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The scriptural or logical basis for רבי אליעזר's order of offerings.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר follows the order of the תורה's text
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר does the offerings in the order the תורה writes them: first what is in ויקרא, then what is in במדבר.
steps.simpleTranslation: He does it the way it is written: first he does what is in תורת כהנים (ויקרא), and then he does what is in חומש הפקודים (במדבר).
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers: רבי אליעזר simply follows the order of the Torah's books.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The special יום הכפורים service is written in פרשת אחרי מות in ויקרא. The מוסף offerings are written in פרשת פנחס in במדבר. Since ויקרא comes first, its service is done first, and the במדבר offerings come afterward.

keyTerms.meaning: As it is written, in the Torah's order

phrases.english: He does it as it is written:
first he does the service of Leviticus,
and then he does the offerings of the book of Numbers.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 2.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי אליעזר follows the order of the Torah's text: the ויקרא service first, then the במדבר מוספין.

steps.title: And what is רבי עקיבא's reason?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for רבי עקיבא's reasoning.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי עקיבא?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to the other side and asks why רבי עקיבא does not follow the תורה's written order. This sets up the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי עקיבא brings some of the מוסף offerings early, together with the morning תמיד. That goes against the simple order of the books, so he needs a source.

keyTerms.meaning: The תנא who puts the מוסף offerings with the morning תמיד

phrases.english: And Rabbi Akiva — what is his reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Parallel question: after רבי אליעזר's reason, the גמרא asks for רבי עקיבא's.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רבי עקיבא departs from the Torah's written order.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא: the additional offerings go with the morning תמיד
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא's reason is the one stated in the ברייתא: "מלבד עולת הבקר" shows that the מוספין are offered together with the morning תמיד.
steps.simpleTranslation: As the reason is taught: "Besides the morning burnt-offering, which is the daily burnt-offering." So we see that the additional offerings are done together with the morning תמיד.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רבי עקיבא's reason was already given in the ברייתא itself. It is a פסוק that links the מוספין to the morning offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק (במדבר כח:כג) mentions the מוספין right next to the morning עולה. רבי עקיבא learns from this that they belong together in time. So the מוסף עולות are offered early, with the morning תמיד, even before the special service of the day.

keyTerms.meaning: As the reason is taught in the ברייתא
The morning burnt-offering, the morning תמיד
The additional offerings of a special day

phrases.english: As the reason is taught in the baraita:
"Besides the morning burnt-offering
which is the daily burnt-offering,"

phrases.aramaic: אַלְמָא מוּסָפִין עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל שַׁחַר
phrases.english: evidently the additional offerings, together with the morning daily offering,
he performs them.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 4.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: "מלבד עולת הבקר" teaches that the מוספין are offered with the morning תמיד.

steps.title: What does רבי אליעזר learn from 'besides the sin-offering of atonement'?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how רבי אליעזר uses the phrase "מלבד חטאת הכפורים", which רבי עקיבא used to fix the place of the outer שעיר.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי אליעזר — this phrase "besides the sin-offering of atonement," what does he do with it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a standard question: if רבי אליעזר doesn't use this פסוק the way רבי עקיבא does, what does he learn from it? This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The assumption is that no words of the תורה are extra. רבי עקיבא used "מלבד חטאת הכפורים" to place the outer שעיר after the inner service. רבי אליעזר doesn't need it for order, since he simply follows the books. So he must use it for something else.

keyTerms.meaning: What does he do with it? What does he learn from it?

phrases.english: And Rabbi Eliezer,
this phrase "besides the sin-offering of atonement"
what does he do with it?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר הַאי מִלְּבַד חַטַּאת הַכִּפּוּרִים מַאי עָבֵיד לֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to the פסוק cited in step 1 and asks how רבי אליעזר reads it.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אליעזר's reading of the פסוק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Every phrase in the Torah teaches something; if רבי אליעזר doesn't use this one for order, it seems to have no purpose for him.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What רבי אליעזר learns from "מלבד חטאת הכפורים".

steps.title: The outer goat atones for what the inner goat atones for
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר uses the phrase to teach that the outer שעיר atones for the same thing that the inner שעיר atones for.
steps.simpleTranslation: He needs that phrase to teach: what this one atones for, that one atones for too.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רבי אליעזר uses the phrase for a different lesson. It teaches what the outer goat atones for, not when it is offered.
steps.deeperAnalysis: By mentioning the outer goat next to the inner "חטאת הכפורים", the Torah links them. Whatever the inner שעיר atones for, the outer שעיר atones for as well. So for רבי אליעזר the פסוק is about the atoning power of the goat, not about the order of the offerings.

keyTerms.meaning: He needs it for a different teaching

keyTerms.term: עַל מָה שֶׁזֶּה מְכַפֵּר — זֶה מְכַפֵּר
keyTerms.meaning: For what this one atones, that one atones

steps.whatToRemember: רבי אליעזר follows the order of the books (ויקרא first, then במדבר). רבי עקיבא puts the מוספין with the morning תמיד because of "מלבד עולת הבקר". The phrase "מלבד חטאת הכפורים" tells רבי עקיבא WHEN the outer goat is offered, and tells רבי אליעזר WHAT the outer goat atones for: the same as the inner goat.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is a classic example of a common גמרא pattern: when one תנא uses a פסוק for one law, the גמרא asks what the other תנא learns from it, and finds him a different teaching from the same words.

phrases.english: That verse is needed by him to teach:

phrases.aramaic: עַל מָה שֶׁזֶּה מְכַפֵּר — זֶה מְכַפֵּר.
phrases.english: for what this one (the inner goat) atones, that one (the outer goat) also atones.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 6 by giving the פסוק a different use for רבי אליעזר.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי אליעזר uses "מלבד חטאת הכפורים" to teach that the outer goat atones for the same thing as the inner goat.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reassigning the פסוק to a different teaching
steps.terutzMaskana: For רבי אליעזר, the phrase teaches what the outer goat atones for, not the order of the offerings.

steps.title: Two more reports of רבי עקיבא's view on the seven lambs
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה reports that one lamb goes with the morning תמיד and six with the afternoon תמיד. רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון reports the opposite: six in the morning and one in the afternoon.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says in רבי עקיבא's name: one lamb is offered with the morning תמיד, and six with the afternoon תמיד. רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון says in his name: six are offered with the morning תמיד, and one with the afternoon תמיד.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא brings two more versions of what רבי עקיבא held about the seven lambs of the יום הכפורים מוסף. Both versions split the lambs into two groups, but they disagree about the numbers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Until now the discussion was about the order of the offerings. Here, two students report that רבי עקיבא divided the seven lambs between morning and afternoon. The two reports are exact mirror images: 1+6 versus 6+1.

keyTerms.meaning: In his name (here: in the name of רבי עקיבא)

steps.confusionAlert: The numbers 'one' and 'six' refer only to the seven lambs (כבשים) of the מוסף. They do not include the bull or the ram.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda says in his name (Rabbi Akiva's):

phrases.aramaic: אֶחָד קָרֵב עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל שַׁחַר,
phrases.english: One is offered with the morning daily offering,

phrases.aramaic: וְשִׁשָּׁה עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם.
phrases.english: and six with the afternoon daily offering.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר מִשְּׁמוֹ:
phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon says in his name:

phrases.aramaic: שִׁשָּׁה קְרֵבִין עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל שַׁחַר,
phrases.english: Six are offered with the morning daily offering,

phrases.aramaic: וְאֶחָד עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם.
phrases.english: and one with the afternoon daily offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds alternative reports of רבי עקיבא's view after the earlier discussion of רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The seven lambs are split between morning and afternoon: 1+6 according to רבי יהודה, 6+1 according to רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון.

steps.title: Why do these two split the lambs at all?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the reason that רבי יהודה and רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון divide the lambs into two groups.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason of the רבנן?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why both of these תנאים split the seven lambs between morning and afternoon. This sets up the next step, which gives the source.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question is about what the two opinions share: dividing the lambs. It does not yet ask about the numbers. That question comes later, in step 11.

keyTerms.meaning: The Rabbis (here: רבי יהודה and רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון)

steps.confusionAlert: Here 'רבנן' does not mean the majority opinion against a single תנא. It simply refers to the two תנאים just quoted, רבי יהודה and רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון.

phrases.english: What is the reasoning of the Rabbis?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the split described in step 8
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for dividing the seven lambs between the morning and afternoon תמיד

steps.title: Two verses point to two times, so the lambs are split
steps.stepSummary: One פסוק links the מוספין to the morning תמיד. Another פסוק places them after the inner service. To fulfill both, some lambs are offered at each time.
steps.simpleTranslation: Two verses are written. It is written: 'Besides the morning burnt-offering,' and it is written: 'And he shall go out and offer his burnt-offering.' Therefore he offers some of them here and some of them there.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that two פסוקים seem to give two different times for the מוספין. So the lambs are divided to satisfy both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The phrase "מלבד עולת הבקר" ties the מוספין to the morning. The פסוק "ויצא ועשה את עולתו ואת עולת העם" comes after the inner service, and "עולת העם" is understood to include the מוספין, which suggests a later time. Splitting the lambs lets both פסוקים be fulfilled.

keyTerms.meaning: And he shall go out and offer his burnt-offering (ויקרא טז)

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows a common method: when two פסוקים seem to point in different directions, the halacha divides the practice so that both are kept.

phrases.english: Two verses are written.
It is written: 'Besides the morning burnt-offering,'
phrases.notes: This verse points to the morning, together with the תמיד.

phrases.english: and it is written: 'And he shall go out and offer his burnt-offering,'
phrases.notes: This verse comes after the inner service, so it points to a later time.

phrases.english: Therefore he offers some of them here
and some of them there.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 9
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Two verses imply two different times, so the lambs are split to fulfill both.

steps.title: What exactly do they disagree about?
steps.stepSummary: Both agree to split the lambs, so the גמרא asks what lies behind their different numbers.
steps.simpleTranslation: About what do they disagree?
steps.whatsHappening: Now that we know why both split the lambs, the גמרא asks why one says 1+6 and the other says 6+1. This sets up the next two steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The shared reason (two פסוקים) does not explain the different numbers. The גמרא looks for the separate concern that drives each opinion.

phrases.english: About what do they disagree?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from what they share to how they differ
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reason behind the 1+6 versus 6+1 split

steps.title: רבי יהודה: offer only one first so the כהן גדול does not get tired
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה holds that the כהן גדול offers just one lamb in the morning to fulfill the פסוק, then does the main service of the day, so that he does not grow weak.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה holds: he offers one, as it is written, 'Besides the morning burnt-offering,' and then he does the service of the day, because perhaps the כהן גדול will become weak.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains רבי יהודה's view. The morning lamb count is kept as small as possible to save the כהן גדול's strength for עבודת היום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: One lamb is enough to fulfill "מלבד עולת הבקר." Only the כהן גדול can do עבודת היום, so if he becomes too weak, the כפרה of the day is at risk. So the rest of the lambs wait until after the main service.

keyTerms.meaning: The special service of the day (יום הכפורים)

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda holds:
He offers one, as it is written: 'Besides the morning burnt-offering,'
and then he performs the service of the day,
lest the High Priest become weak.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: First half of the answer to step 11
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי יהודה minimizes the morning offerings out of concern that the כהן גדול will become weak before עבודת היום.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון: once he starts, do six so he will not neglect them later
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון holds that once the כהן גדול starts, he offers six lambs, because he might be careless about many leftover lambs later. He is not worried about weakness, since the כהן גדול is energetic for עבודת היום.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון holds: since he has started, he offers six, because perhaps he will be negligent later. And regarding the service of the day, he is diligent.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the opposite view. Do as many lambs as possible now, and leave only one for later.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His concern runs the other way: lambs left for the end of a long day may be neglected. He answers רבי יהודה's worry by saying the כהן גדול will always find the energy for עבודת היום. So the real danger is neglecting the lambs, not tiring before the main service.
steps.whatToRemember: Both versions of רבי עקיבא split the seven lambs because of two פסוקים. רבי יהודה (1 in the morning, 6 later) fears the כהן גדול will grow weak before עבודת היום. רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון (6 in the morning, 1 later) fears the leftover lambs will be neglected, and trusts that the כהן גדול is always eager for עבודת היום.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon holds:
Since he has begun, he offers six,
lest he be negligent (later).
For regarding the service of the day, he is diligent.
phrases.notes: Answers רבי יהודה's worry about weakness

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second half of the answer to step 11, contrasting with step 12
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון maximizes the morning offerings out of fear of later negligence, trusting that the כהן גדול is eager for עבודת היום.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The dispute over 1+6 versus 6+1 is a dispute over which risk is greater: the כהן גדול's weakness or his negligence.

steps.title: Everyone agrees there is only one ram
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא observes that, whatever their disagreements, all the views in the ברייתא (רבי אליעזר and every version of רבי עקיבא) count only one איל for the people. Their lists have just "אילו ואיל העם".
steps.simpleTranslation: In any case, according to everyone (in this dispute), there is only one ram.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out a detail that all the opinions in the ברייתא share: none of them lists a separate מוסף ram, only "אילו ואיל העם". This sets up the next question about whose view that is.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא argue about the order of the offerings, but each list has only "אילו ואיל העם", with no extra ram for the מוסף. So the גמרא notes that every opinion assumes the people's ram of the day's service and the ram of the מוספין are one and the same animal.

keyTerms.meaning: According to everyone (all opinions in the dispute)

phrases.english: According to everyone, in any case,
there is one ram.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the lamb dispute, steps back to note a shared assumption in the ברייתא's listed orders (step 1): only one people's ram.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: All the opinions in the ברייתא hold that only one ram is offered for the people.

steps.title: Whose view is the single ram?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks which תנא holds that there is only one ram.
steps.simpleTranslation: In accordance with whom (is this)?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks which earlier authority holds that only one ram is brought. This sets up a source from a ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Not every תנא agrees that there is just one ram. So the גמרא wants to find which side of a known dispute these two תנאים are following.

phrases.english: In accordance with whom?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the shared assumption noted in step 14.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which תנא holds that there is only one ram.

steps.title: It follows רבי, who says the two rams are really one
steps.stepSummary: The single ram matches רבי, who teaches in a ברייתא that the ram in אחרי מות is the same ram listed in חומש הפקודים.
steps.simpleTranslation: In accordance with רבי. As it was taught in a ברייתא: רבי says: The one ram that is mentioned here is the same one that is mentioned in the Book of Numbers.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the single-ram view belongs to רבי, and quotes a ברייתא to show it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה mentions a ram in two places: in the יום כיפור service in ויקרא, and in the list of מוספין in במדבר. רבי says these are not two separate animals. They are one ram, described twice.

keyTerms.meaning: As it was taught in a ברייתא
That is stated here (in פרשת אחרי מות)

steps.confusionAlert: "רבי" with no other name means רבי יהודה הנשיא. He is a different person from רבי יהודה in the lamb dispute above.

phrases.english: In accordance with Rabbi (Yehuda HaNasi).
As it was taught: Rabbi says:
The one ram that is stated here
is the one stated in the Book of Numbers.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 15 by naming רבי and citing a ברייתא.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The single-ram view is רבי's, who identifies the ram of ויקרא with the ram of במדבר.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ברייתא: רבי אומר איל אחד האמור כאן הוא האמור בחומש הפקודים

steps.title: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון counts two rams
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא continues: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון holds that there are two separate rams.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון says: There are two rams, one stated here and one stated in the Book of Numbers.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא gives the opposing view: two different rams, one for each פסוק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון, the ram in ויקרא belongs to the special service of the day. The ram in במדבר is a separate ram that belongs to the מוספין. So the ברייתא's one-ram order follows רבי, not רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון's own view.

phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon says:
They are two rams:
one stated here,
and one stated in the Book of Numbers.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: שְׁנֵי אֵילִים הֵן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing opinion within the same ברייתא.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Two rams are brought: one for the service of the day and one for the מוספין.

steps.title: What is רבי's reason?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of רבי's view that there is only one ram.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason of רבי?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why רבי says there is just one ram. The answer comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two separate mentions of a ram usually suggest two animals. So רבי needs a textual basis to merge them into one.

phrases.english: What is the reason of Rabbi?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of רבי's position from step 16.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The scriptural source for רבי's view of a single ram.

steps.title: The word "אחד" teaches one ram
steps.stepSummary: רבי learns from the פסוק's word "אחד" that there is only one ram.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because it is written: "One."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the פסוק says "one ram," so רבי understands that only one ram is brought.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק in במדבר says "איל אחד". רבי reads the word "אחד" as limiting: there is only one ram on this day, so it must be the same one mentioned in ויקרא.

phrases.english: As it is written: "One."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 18.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The word "אחד" in the פסוק limits it to a single ram.

steps.title: How does רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון read "אחד"?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון does with the word "אחד".
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון — what does "one" mean (to him)?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks how the second opinion explains the word "one" if he holds there are two rams.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If "אחד" means only one ram, it seems to contradict רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון. He must read the word in some other way.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon —
what is "one"?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns רבי's proof-word against the other view and asks how he explains it.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: How the two-rams view explains the word "אחד".

steps.title: "אחד" means the best of the flock
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון reads "אחד" as "the unique one", meaning the choicest animal of the flock.
steps.simpleTranslation: The special one of its flock.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that for רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון, "one" is not a count. It means "the outstanding one", the best animal.
steps.deeperAnalysis: "אחד" can mean "unique" or "special". So the word teaches a quality requirement, that the ram must be the best of its flock, not a limit on how many rams there are.

keyTerms.meaning: The choicest (most outstanding) of its flock

phrases.english: The unique (choicest) one of its flock.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 20.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: "אחד" teaches that the ram must be the best of the flock.

steps.title: Where does רבי learn the best-of-the-flock rule?
steps.stepSummary: Since רבי uses "אחד" for counting, the גמרא asks where he learns that a קרבן must be choice.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי? (From where does he learn that it must be the choicest?)
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns back to רבי. Since he used "אחד" to count, it asks where he learns that the animal must be the best.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both sides agree that the קרבן should be choice. If רבי used up the word "אחד" for counting, he needs a different source for the quality rule.

phrases.english: And Rabbi (from where does he learn the choicest requirement)?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks how רבי gets the rule that step 21 derived from "אחד".
steps.sheelahInformationSought: רבי's source for the requirement that the animal be choice.

steps.title: רבי learns it from "מבחר נדריך"
steps.stepSummary: רבי learns that קרבנות must be choice from the פסוק "מבחר נדריך".
steps.simpleTranslation: He derives it from "your choice vows".
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רבי has a different פסוק, "the choice of your vows", which teaches that קרבנות must be the best.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק in דברים calls the offerings "מבחר", the choicest. That gives a general rule for all קרבנות, so רבי does not need the word "אחד" for it.

phrases.english: He derives it
from "your choice vows."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 22.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי learns the choice-animal rule from "מבחר נדריך".

steps.title: Why does רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון need two sources?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון needs "אחד" if "מבחר נדריך" already teaches the rule.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון? (Why does he need both פסוקים?)
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks: if "מבחר נדריך" already teaches the rule, why does רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון also need "אחד" for it?
steps.deeperAnalysis: There seems to be a duplicate source. The גמרא wants to know what each פסוק adds, so that neither one is extra.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon (why does he need both)?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the apparent repetition between steps 21 and 23.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון needs both "אחד" and "מבחר נדריך".

steps.title: One פסוק for obligatory, one for voluntary
steps.stepSummary: One פסוק teaches the rule for obligatory קרבנות and the other for voluntary ones. Both are needed.
steps.simpleTranslation: One is for an obligatory offering, and one is for a voluntary offering. And both are necessary.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that each פסוק covers a different type of קרבן, so neither is extra.
steps.deeperAnalysis: "אחד" is said about an obligatory קרבן (חובה). "מבחר נדריך" is about voluntary gifts (נדבה). You could not learn one from the other. A voluntary gift may need to be choice because it is a gift, and an obligation may need to be choice because one should fulfill a duty in the finest way. So both פסוקים are needed.
steps.whatToRemember: רבי: "אחד" means one ram, and "מבחר נדריך" teaches choice animals. רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון: two rams, "אחד" means the best of the flock for חובה, and "מבחר נדריך" teaches the same for נדבה.

phrases.english: One is for an obligatory offering,
and one is for a voluntary offering.
And they are both necessary.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 24 and closes the discussion of the rams.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: "אחד" covers חובה and "מבחר נדריך" covers נדבה. Neither can be learned from the other.

steps.title: Back to the משנה: he washed his hands and feet
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא returns to the next words of the משנה: the כהן גדול sanctified his hands and feet.
steps.simpleTranslation: (The משנה said:) He sanctified his hands and his feet.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new topic by quoting the next line of the משנה. It is setting up a discussion of the כהן גדול going back into the קודש הקדשים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the מוספין, the כהן גדול washes his hands and feet again before entering the קודש הקדשים. This quote opens the next section of the גמרא.

keyTerms.meaning: He sanctified (washed from the כיור) his hands and feet

phrases.english: He sanctified his hands and feet.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new section by quoting the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן גדול sanctifies his hands and feet before the next stage of the service.

steps.title: A ברייתא quotes "ובא אהרן אל אהל מועד"
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא brings the פסוק that describes אהרן coming into the אהל מועד.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן taught: "And אהרן shall come into the Tent of Meeting."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא that starts with a פסוק about אהרן entering. It is setting up the question of why he enters.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק is understood to mean that the כהן גדול enters the קודש הקדשים once more. The ברייתא will explain the purpose of this extra entry.

keyTerms.meaning: Tent of Meeting (here: the קודש הקדשים)

phrases.english: The Sages taught:
"And Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting."

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״וּבָא אַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד״
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a ברייתא about the stage of the service in the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The פסוק records a further entry of אהרן into the אהל מועד.

steps.title: Why does he go in?
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא asks what the purpose of this entry is.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why does he come?
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא asks why the כהן גדול needs to go in again.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק does not say why he enters. Since the main קודש הקדשים service is already finished, the ברייתא asks what is left to do there.

phrases.english: Why does he come?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks the purpose of the entry described in step 27.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The purpose of the כהן גדול's entry.

steps.title: To take out the spoon and the coal pan
steps.stepSummary: He enters to remove the כף (incense spoon) and מחתה (coal pan) left inside earlier.
steps.simpleTranslation: To take out the spoon and the coal pan.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא answers that he goes in to take out the כף and the מחתה that he left there during the קטורת service. The ברייתא continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier in the day, the כהן גדול brought the קטורת into the קודש הקדשים in a כף, with coals in a מחתה, and left the vessels there. Now he goes back in to remove them.

phrases.english: To take out the spoon
and the coal pan,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 28. The ברייתא continues on the next amud.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: He enters to remove the כף and the מחתה.
